descriptionByRoom.1: Inside the bark hut. The door leads north to the clearing.
descriptionByRoom.2: Hut clearing: locked door south, forest west, clover field east.
descriptionByRoom.3: Forest path: clearing east, river cliff west. Water glints through the trees.
descriptionByRoom.4: Clover field: the hut clearing is west; Mount Ymir's slopes lie east.
descriptionByRoom.5: Cliff above the Gioll: forest east; a path descends south to the bank.
descriptionByRoom.6: Riverbank: cliff north, crater west, rocky outcrop east.
descriptionByRoom.7: The Gioll pours into a crater. West is a fatal drop. The safe path returns east.
descriptionByRoom.8: A distant string bridge is visible south-east, beyond the trees. Reach it via the forest; return west.
descriptionByRoom.9: Windy slopes of Mount Ymir: clover field west, bridge approach south.
descriptionByRoom.10: The string bridge crosses the Gioll southwards. Mount Ymir's slopes are north.
descriptionByRoom.11: On the swaying string bridge. Follow it north or south; no footing east or west.
descriptionByRoom.12: Southern bank: string bridge north, oak forest west, rope cliff east.
descriptionByRoom.13: A rock amid poisonous mushrooms: bridge landing east, basalt clearing south.
descriptionByRoom.14: Basalt clearing: oak forest north, cave entrance south.
descriptionByRoom.15: A shelf above the Gioll's southern bank. The path west returns to the bridge landing.
descriptionByRoom.16: Daylit cave entrance: outside north, passages south and east. Take a light first.
descriptionByRoom.17: An explorer scratched: Seek the sacred key of Thialfi. The passage returns west.
descriptionByRoom.18: Entrance cavern: daylight north, old torture chamber west.
descriptionByRoom.19: The legendary treasure room of the black elves of Svartalfheim. Only exit: west.
descriptionByRoom.20: Treasure doorway: south returns to the northern cavern.
descriptionByRoom.21: Northern cavern: treasure door north, corridor east, long tunnel south.
descriptionByRoom.22: Draughty corridor: cavern west, torture chamber south.
descriptionByRoom.23: An old torture chamber, stained with blood. Corridor north; entrance cavern east.
descriptionByRoom.24: Long tunnel: cavern north, round chamber south. A sealed crack glows faintly east.
descriptionByRoom.25: Empty side cave. The only exit is west to the round chamber.
descriptionByRoom.26: Loki's round chamber: tunnel north, upper ledge south, bat caves west, side cave east.
descriptionByRoom.27: Upper ledge above an underground river: round chamber north, temple balcony east.
descriptionByRoom.28: Temple balcony: sturdy stone rail, floor below. West returns to the upper ledge.
descriptionByRoom.29: Draughty junction: round chamber east, bat colony south, forked pillar west.
descriptionByRoom.30: Forked stone pillar: junction east, pale chamber west.
descriptionByRoom.31: Low, dripping passage: pale chamber north, key chamber east.
descriptionByRoom.32: Pale limestone chamber: forked pillar east, low passage south.
descriptionByRoom.33: Bat colony: mind the droppings! Junction north, key chamber west.
descriptionByRoom.34: Key chamber: bat colony east, low passage west.
descriptionByRoom.35: Loki's temple: gate north, balcony overhead.
descriptionByRoom.36: Lower cavern: shaft north, lower river ledge east.
descriptionByRoom.37: Crypt: temple gate south, sealed passage east. Four stones name its keeper.
descriptionByRoom.38: Cell: crypt west, shaft east, service hatch north. Its latch is on the drain side.
descriptionByRoom.39: Beyond the shaft: cell west, lower cavern south.
descriptionByRoom.40: Lower river ledge: cavern west. Paths lead north to the waterfall and south to a river bend. East is a sheer edge.
descriptionByRoom.41: Straight drain: conduit west, passage east towards the junction.
descriptionByRoom.42: Straight drain: conduit west, junction east.
descriptionByRoom.43: Drain junction: a winding path north leads to the pearl chamber. Branch east, conduit west; OPEN HATCH south.
descriptionByRoom.44: Blind drainage branch: return west to the junction.
descriptionByRoom.45: The Gioll falls through the roof. Stone steps climb north; the lower ledge is south. No safe footing east.
descriptionByRoom.46: Pearl-white chamber: steps west; a winding path south leads to the drain junction.
descriptionByRoom.47: Top of the stone steps: waterfall south, pearl-white chamber east.
descriptionByRoom.48: At a river bend, the castle is visible across the water east. Return north, or cross the drawbridge east. No path south.
descriptionByRoom.49: Drawbridge: river ledge west, castle courtyard east. Crossing secures the bridge.
descriptionByRoom.50: Castle courtyard: hzb tzozi. Drawbridge west, magazine east; tunnel south to bank.
descriptionByRoom.51: Powder magazine: return west to the courtyard.
descriptionByRoom.52: Eastern riverbank: castle tunnel north, wooden bridge west.
descriptionByRoom.53: Wooden bridge: eastern bank east, conduit service path north.
descriptionByRoom.54: Freezing conduit: drains east, service path south to the wooden bridge.
